mechanics.behavior: Triple Kick Gen III checks each of three kicks separately at base power 10, 20, 30; the attack stops after a miss.

animation.origin: Three staggered kick slashes start from the attacker and converge toward the foe.
animation.travel: The slashes follow three staggered arcs instead of one large generic projectile.
animation.contact: Three discrete impact bursts appear at different target offsets in sequence.
animation.aftermath: Short spark and swipe trails fade as the third kick finishes.

mechanics.behavior: Thief in FireRed uses Dark as the Special category with power 40, PP 10 and 100 accuracy; it may steal a held item if the attacker carries none.

animation.contact: A single slash and star flash marks the theft attempt at the target.
animation.aftermath: A small glint returns toward the caster; held-item transfer remains unsupported in the isolated lab.

mechanics.behavior: Snore in Generation III is Normal Physical, power 40, PP 15, usable only asleep, with a chance to flinch the target.

animation.origin: A soft bubble pulse appears close to the sleeping Pokémon.

animation.contact: Successive wavy pulses converge on the target instead of producing a sword slash.
animation.aftermath: The final wave fades and the caster's sleep-themed puff vanishes.

mechanics.behavior: Octazooka Gen III is a Water Special attack with power 65, PP 10 and accuracy 85; it may lower the target's accuracy by one stage.

animation.origin: A dark purple ink-like orb forms immediately in front of the attacker.
animation.travel: An opaque ink projectile arcs toward the opponent with small trailing droplets.
animation.contact: At impact, twelve ink droplets spread radially around the target.
animation.aftermath: Ink splashes and a short ripple dissolve. Accuracy reduction is not claimed implemented by the visual preview.
